rationale.conceptual: The method is an established but non-trivial multi-part algorithm. It requires building a dynamical matrix from spin-wave equations, diagonalizing for each k-point, computing surface and bulk contributions via integration, and applying sum-rule-fixed phase jumps. The underlying theory (surface magnons, density-of-states phase shifts) is moderately complex and must be correctly translated into numerical code, though the paper provides detailed formulas.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of 4-5 sequential processing steps (setup, spectrum diagonalization, surface contribution integration, bulk redistribution, final assembly) all within a single Python script using standard scientific libraries. I/O is trivial (one JSON output), and there are no external data fetches or fragile multi-tool orchestrations.
